name: ZETRIX
recent: Zetrix AI 近期面临多项法律与财务事件：遭 Macquarie Bank 就 RM2 百万股息付款提出清盘呈请，公司已取得 interim court order 阻止清盘行动；同时政府就 RM314 百万 JPJ 欠款提起诉讼，公司提出 RM100 百万预付款以恢复 JPJ 收款角色。此外，MARC Ratings 因未支付 RM25 百万将公司 sukuk 下调至 default。
notable: 公司取得 interim court order，阻止 Macquarie Bank 就 RM2 百万股息付款提出的清盘呈请。
政府就 RM314 百万 JPJ 欠款对 Zetrix AI 提起诉讼。
公司提出 RM100 百万预付款，以恢复 JPJ 收款角色。
risks: Macquarie Bank 就 RM2 百万股息付款发出法定要求并提出清盘呈请。
政府就 RM314 百万 JPJ 欠款提起诉讼。
MARC Ratings 将公司 sukuk 下调至 default，涉及未支付 RM25 百万。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度 revenue 为 RM426.7 百万，环比增长 10.5%，同比增长 38.6%；net income 为 RM269.3 百万，环比下降 0.8%，同比增长 35.2%；net margin 为 63.1%，低于上一季度的 70.2%。

recent_en: Zetrix AI has recently faced several legal and financial events: Macquarie Bank filed a winding-up petition over a RM2 million dividend payment, and the company obtained an interim court order to block the winding-up action. Meanwhile, the government is suing over RM314 million in JPJ arrears, and the company offered a RM100 million upfront payment to regain its JPJ collection role. Additionally, MARC Ratings downgraded the company's sukuk to default over unpaid RM25 million.
notable_en: The company obtained an interim court order to block Macquarie Bank's winding-up petition over a RM2 million dividend payment.
The government filed a lawsuit against Zetrix AI over RM314 million in JPJ arrears.
The company offered a RM100 million upfront payment to regain its JPJ collection role.
risks_en: Macquarie Bank issued a statutory demand and filed a winding-up petition over a RM2 million dividend payment.
The government filed a lawsuit over RM314 million in JPJ arrears.
MARC Ratings downgraded the company's sukuk to default over unpaid RM25 million.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM426.7 million, up 10.5% QoQ and 38.6% YoY; net income was RM269.3 million, down 0.8% QoQ but up 35.2% YoY; net margin was 63.1%, lower than 70.2% in the previous quarter.
